title: Joint surjectivity of a finite family descends to a stage
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a system of qcqs schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition maps [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and $(X,\pi)$ a limit cone. Fix $i$, a finite set $B$, finite-presentation $D_i$-schemes $U_b,V$, and $D_i$-morphisms $f_b:U_b\to V$ that are locally of finite presentation. Assume their pullbacks to $X$ are jointly surjective on points. Then there are $i_1$, $h_1:i_1\to i$ such that for every $h:j\to i_1$ and every point $x\in V_j$, some $b\in B$ and $y\in(U_b)_j$ satisfy $(f_b)_j(y)=x$. Here subscript denotes direct pullback [def-pc-fibre-product] along $D(h\circ h_1)$. No diagram or etaleness is assumed.

proof.text: Construct W as the Over object whose source is the finite coproduct of the U_b, with the induced structure map. Construct g:W to V and l_b:U_b to W by Sigma.desc and Sigma.iota; l_b composed with g equals f_b. The finite-presentation structure maps give qcqs sources and target; finite_coproduct_lfp_qcqs gives qcqs W and locally finite presentation of g.

Functoriality of Over.pullback transports l_b composed with g=f_b. Each point lift supplied by the assumed joint surjectivity can thus be mapped through the pulled-back l_b, proving the pulled-back g surjective. Apply exists_surjective_of_isLimit (07RR).

For every base change, Scheme.Pullback.range_map identifies the image of the pulled-back g with the inverse image of its original image under the target first projection. A target point at j maps to a target point at i_1 by the canonical pullback.map; their first projections agree. Surjectivity at i_1 therefore implies image membership, hence a lift under g_j.

Project that source lift to W and use sigmaOpenCover to find a coproduct summand containing it. Apply the same pullback image formula to l_b to lift the actual source point to the pulled-back summand (without identifying pullback points with pairs). Functoriality of the equation l_b composed with g=f_b then gives the required family lift. For an empty B all point-existence assumptions force the relevant targets to be empty; the identical proof applies.

lean.statement: theorem finite_family_joint_surjectivity_stage {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (B : Type v) [Finite B] (i : Iᵒᵖ) (U : B → Over (D.obj i)) (V : Over (D.obj i)) (f : ∀ b, U b ⟶ V) (hU : ∀ b, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (U b).hom ∧ QuasiCompact (U b).hom ∧ QuasiSeparated (U b).hom) (hV : LocallyOfFinitePresentation V.hom ∧ QuasiCompact V.hom ∧ QuasiSeparated V.hom) (hf : ∀ b, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f b).left) (hcov : ∀ x : ((Over.pullback (c.π.app i)).obj V).left, ∃ b, ∃ y : ((Over.pullback (c.π.app i)).obj (U b)).left, ((Over.pullback (c.π.app i)).map (f b)).left y = x) : ∃ (i₁ : Iᵒᵖ) (h₁ : i₁ ⟶ i), ∀ (j : Iᵒᵖ) (h : j ⟶ i₁), ∀ x : ((Over.pullback (D.map (h ≫ h₁))).obj V).left, ∃ b, ∃ y : ((Over.pullback (D.map (h ≫ h₁))).obj (U b)).left, ((Over.pullback (D.map (h ≫ h₁))).map (f b)).left y = x
